verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor documentation of open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux driver support for the B200. The only related item is a community thread conceding the HGX B200 stack 'isn't a fully open GPU stack' because Fabric Manager is closed source, which does not establish a documented open driver.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run this GPU on an open driver — open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux support documented by the vendor
